description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for managing projects within the Coocook application. It includes actions for viewing, editing, creating, importing, exporting, and deleting projects, as well as handling project-specific URLs and permissions.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Project
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for project-related actions in the Coocook application.

methods.name: fallback_old_url_scheme
methods.description: Handles deprecated URL scheme fallback by redirecting based on project URL name.

methods.name: id_only
methods.description: Shortcut for accessing a project by ID without additional URL parts.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures project ID and URL name, loads project object, and sets up project URLs and inventory.

methods.name: submenu
methods.description: Sets up submenu items for project views.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays project days and meals, with permission checks.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares data for editing project meals and dishes.

methods.name: get_project_plan_ajax
methods.description: Returns project plan data in JSON format for AJAX requests.

methods.name: move_meal_or_dish_ajax
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to move meals or dishes within a project.

methods.name: settings
methods.description: Displays project settings page.

methods.name: exportable_projects
methods.description: Returns list of projects that can be exported from.

methods.name: get_import
methods.description: Prepares data for importing projects.

methods.name: post_import
methods.description: Handles importing data from another project.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new project.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates project description.

methods.name: archive
methods.description: Archives a project.

methods.name: unarchive
methods.description: Unarchives a project.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames a project.

methods.name: visibility
methods.description: Changes project visibility (public/private).

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a project after confirmation.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to the project show page.
